games.name: [Nightmare] Pocong: Cursed Hospital [Scary Horror]
games.desc:
PvP Mode Added!

A restless soul, the "Pocong," wanders the halls of an abandoned hospital. As an investigator, uncover the truth, collect lost belongings, and perform the ritual to lay the spirit to rest.

Will you soothe the soul, or become the hospital’s next target...?

📝 HOW TO PLAY:

🔍 INVESTIGATE: Search for items required for the ritual.
🏃 SURVIVE: Run and hide from the Pocong roaming the corridors!
🕯️ RITUAL: Return items to the desk to awaken the spirit's memories.
🚪 ESCAPE: Complete all 4 stages to break the curse.

⚠️ WARNING: This game contains intense jumpscares, flashing lights, and loud noises. Play at your own risk. Headphones recommended for the best experience.

🌸I'm a solo indie developer from Japan. Thank you so much for playing and supporting my game! If you enjoy the game, please support me by leaving a 👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite!

Tags: Horror, Scary, Pocong, Ghost, Multiplayer, Jumpscare, Indonesia, Survival, PvP

games.name: [CHURCH] Anomaly Watch
games.desc:
Anomaly Watch is a horror game inspired by the Mandela Catalogue and the I'm On Observation Duty games. In Anomaly Watch you are sent to explore a rural house where unexplainable events happen, objects go missing, become distorted, and strange humanoids appear. Your job is to recognize and report unexplainable events and most importantly, report unrecognizable creatures and intruders. All in all survive until 6 am. Good Luck!

House Keybinds:
PC: Equip Tablet - R
Mobile: Equip Tablet - Button on side of the screen.

Office Keybinds:
Flashlight: F or Gamepad B
Sprint: Left Shift or Gamepad R1
Exiting the reporter: Jump

Horror outside human comprehension.
Thank you for playing Anomaly Watch

Developer: punitto

games.name: Slap Battles Tower Defense
